  input aclk,

  input [31:0] s_axi_awaddr,

  output [0:0] s_axi_awready,

  input [0:0] s_axi_rready,
  output [63:0] m_axi_awaddr,
  output [5:0] m_axi_awprot,
  output [1:0] m_axi_awvalid,

  output [63:0] m_axi_wdata,
  output [7:0] m_axi_wstrb,

reg [0:0] s_axi_awready_reg;
reg [0:0] s_axi_wready_reg;
reg [1:0] s_axi_bresp_reg;
reg [0:0] s_axi_bvalid_reg;
reg [0:0] s_axi_arready_reg;
reg [31:0] s_axi_rdata_reg;
reg [1:0] s_axi_rresp_reg;
reg [0:0] s_axi_rvalid_reg;

reg [63:0] m_axi_awaddr_reg;
reg [5:0] m_axi_awprot_reg;
reg [1:0] m_axi_awvalid_reg;
reg [63:0] m_axi_wdata_reg;
reg [7:0] m_axi_wstrb_reg;
reg [1:0] m_axi_wvalid_reg;
reg [1:0] m_axi_bready_reg;
reg [63:0] m_axi_araddr_reg;
reg [5:0] m_axi_arprot_reg;
reg [1:0] m_axi_arvalid_reg;
reg [1:0] m_axi_rready_reg;

// Assign outputs
assign s_axi_awready = s_axi_awready_reg;
assign s_axi_wready = s_axi_wready_reg;
assign s_axi_bresp = s_axi_bresp_reg;
assign s_axi_bvalid = s_axi_bvalid_reg;
assign s_axi_arready = s_axi_arready_reg;
assign s_axi_rdata = s_axi_rdata_reg;
assign s_axi_rresp = s_axi_rresp_reg;
assign s_axi_rvalid = s_axi_rvalid_reg;

assign m_axi_awaddr = m_axi_awaddr_reg;
assign m_axi_awprot = m_axi_awprot_reg;
assign m_axi_awvalid = m_axi_awvalid_reg;
assign m_axi_wdata = m_axi_wdata_reg;
assign m_axi_wstrb = m_axi_wstrb_reg;
assign m_axi_wvalid = m_axi_wvalid_reg;
assign m_axi_bready = m_axi_bready_reg;
assign m_axi_araddr = m_axi_araddr_reg;
assign m_axi_arprot = m_axi_arprot_reg;
assign m_axi_arvalid = m_axi_arvalid_reg;
assign m_axi_rready = m_axi_rready_reg;

// Initial Values for outputs
initial begin
  s_axi_awready_reg <= 0;
  s_axi_wready_reg <= 0;
  s_axi_bresp_reg <= 0;
  s_axi_bvalid_reg <= 0;
  s_axi_arready_reg <= 0;
  s_axi_rdata_reg <= 0;
  s_axi_rresp_reg <= 0;
  s_axi_rvalid_reg <= 0;

  m_axi_awaddr_reg <= 0;
  m_axi_awprot_reg <= 0;
  m_axi_awvalid_reg <= 0;
  m_axi_wdata_reg <= 0;
  m_axi_wstrb_reg <= 0;
  m_axi_wvalid_reg <= 0;
  m_axi_bready_reg <= 0;
  m_axi_araddr_reg <= 0;
  m_axi_arprot_reg <= 0;
  m_axi_arvalid_reg <= 0;
  m_axi_rready_reg <= 0;
end

// New logic added to remove dependency on external code
always @(posedge aclk) begin
  if (~aresetn) begin
    // Reset
    s_axi_awready_reg <= 0;
    s_axi_wready_reg <= 0;
    s_axi_bresp_reg <= 0;
    s_axi_bvalid_reg <= 0;
    s_axi_arready_reg <= 0;
    s_axi_rdata_reg <= 0;
    s_axi_rresp_reg <= 0;
    s_axi_rvalid_reg <= 0;

    m_axi_awaddr_reg <= 0;
    m_axi_awprot_reg <= 0;
    m_axi_awvalid_reg <= 0;
    m_axi_wdata_reg <= 0;
    m_axi_wstrb_reg <= 0;
    m_axi_wvalid_reg <= 0;
    m_axi_bready_reg <= 0;
    m_axi_araddr_reg <= 0;
    m_axi_arprot_reg <= 0;
    m_axi_arvalid_reg <= 0;
    m_axi_rready_reg <= 0;
  end else begin
    // Example AXI transactions (add more logic based on actual requirements)
    if (s_axi_awvalid && !s_axi_awready_reg) s_axi_awready_reg <= 1;
    else s_axi_awready_reg <= 0;
    
    if (s_axi_wvalid && !s_axi_wready_reg) s_axi_wready_reg <= 1;
    else s_axi_wready_reg <= 0;
    
    if (s_axi_bready && !s_axi_bvalid_reg) begin
      s_axi_bresp_reg <= 2'b00; // OKAY
      s_axi_bvalid_reg <= 1;
    end else s_axi_bvalid_reg <= 0;
    
    if (s_axi_arvalid && !s_axi_arready_reg) s_axi_arready_reg <= 1;
    else s_axi_arready_reg <= 0;
    
    if (s_axi_rready && !s_axi_rvalid_reg) begin
      s_axi_rdata_reg <= 32'hDEADBEEF;
      s_axi_rresp_reg <= 2'b00; // OKAY
      s_axi_rvalid_reg <= 1;
    end else s_axi_rvalid_reg <= 0;
    // More transaction logic could be added as needed...
  end
end

endmodule
